description: Returns official recall notices. Category kids checks up to 6 baby and child items with optional ages and country, including recall matches, same-brand notices and relevant safe-sleep and tip-over guidance. Coverage: US, UK, Canada and EU. In the US, category 'product' searches CPSC consumer-product recalls by words in the product name (brand plus product type, e.g. 'Rowenta vacuum'); 'food_drug' searches FDA food, drug and medical device enforcement reports (e.g. 'CPAP', 'insulin pump'); 'vehicle' searches NHTSA by make, model and model year. country 'GB' searches UK OPSS product recalls and Food Standards Agency alerts; 'CA' Health Canada; an EU or EEA country (e.g. 'DE', 'France') the EU Safety Gate alerts on dangerous non-food products and vehicles from the last three years. An empty result means no notice was found; it does not mean an item is free of recalls elsewhere. Applies to questions about whether a product, food, drug, medical device or vehicle has a recall notice. Results report what the official sources say and are not a safety assessment. Not medical advice.

ages.description: For kids: children’s ages, used for safety guidance

category.description: product (CPSC), food_drug (FDA food, drugs and medical devices), vehicle (NHTSA), or kids (a list of child items); inferred when left out

country.description: Country whose notices are searched: United States (default), United Kingdom, Canada or any EU/EEA country

items.description: For kids: up to 6 child items, brand plus product

query.description: Product, food, drug or medical device words, for product and food_drug, e.g. 'stroller', 'peanut butter' or 'CPAP'
